$comment: Per-file lint exceptions (SEC-60, docs/15 §11). Each entry lists exact files, the rules switched off and the reason. Inline eslint-disable comments are ignored in src/.

exceptions.reason: saveFile() is the one approved download helper (DSN-15-06, docs/15 §11 CSV): it puts the server's CSV export, re-typed as text/csv, on a temporary <a download> under a sanitised file name and revokes the object URL afterwards. No other file may create object URLs.
